about.label: The Group
about.body: Grupo Saturno is a 100% Uruguayan company with over 36 years in the meat industry. We operate two own plants — Frigorífico Saturno and Establecimiento Florida 365 — with active approvals to export to China (GACC), the United States (USDA), the European Union, and third countries. Every animal is individually identified from birth, under the world's most rigorous traceability system. From slaughter to shipment, without intermediaries.

mvv.label: Purpose
mvv.mision: To reach the table of every corner of the World, bringing food that fosters nutrition, health, moments of togetherness, happiness and peace.
mvv.vision:
To be a company that constantly learns and evolves, optimising resources and nurturing a skilled and committed team, with appropriate infrastructure, equipment and a positive working environment, in order to offer comprehensive solutions and adapt them to our clients' needs.

We are committed to sustainable growth and continuous improvement, seeking to generate a positive impact on our team, clients, partners and the community.

We aspire to remain recognised for our empathy, integrity and reliability — fundamental and non-negotiable values — strengthening strategic and lasting relationships with all stakeholders, while maintaining a competitive spirit.

chain.label: How we work
chain.body1: Our cattle graze on our own fields in Uruguay. Slaughter takes place at Establecimiento Florida 365. Processing, deboning and vacuum packing happen at our industrial plant. We coordinate distribution ourselves. The importer does not negotiate with a trader — they negotiate directly with the people who have known the animal since birth.
chain.body2: That is what vertical integration means in practice. Not as a marketing concept, but as something that changes the price, the control and the traceability of every kilo that leaves our plants.

items.title: From slaughter to shipment — inside the group
items.text: Establecimiento Florida 365 is our own slaughter plant. We produce, process, and export without handing control to third parties. One point of contact, real traceability at every stage.

items.title: Four markets. One supplier.
items.text: We hold active export approvals for China (GACC), the United States (USDA), the European Union, and third countries. These are not targets — they are current certifications. If your market is one of them, we already meet its requirements.

items.title: The most rigorous traceability system on the planet
items.text: Uruguay is the only country in the world where 100% of the bovine herd is individually identified electronically from birth, by law. Every animal we process has a complete, verifiable history.

items.title: Grass-fed Uruguayan beef: the world's best, with scientific backing
items.text: A study published in Meat Sciences (Netherlands) concludes that Uruguay scientifically produces the best beef in the world. No growth hormones, on natural pastures year-round.

florida.presentationBody: Establecimiento Florida 365 is Grupo Saturno's own slaughter plant, acquired in 2025 and reopened in March 2026. With active approvals to export to China, the United States and the European Union, it is the link that completes the group's vertical integration: from field to the world, without intermediaries.
